'''Education''' was a series of agencies that were part of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]]. Education's mandate was to promote the values of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] throughout education. Unlike [[SAGEducation/Legends|SAGEducation]] members, Education personnel did not teach, but produced reports of how [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] could restructure their education systems to reflect the ideology of the New Order. However, Education's activities were met with derision throughout the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Select Committee/Legends|Select Committee]] used Education as a dumping ground for politically useful but incompetent personnel, and being reassigned to Education was referred to as being "sent to the idea dusters."<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector's]] Education agency refused to give a reason for the termination of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Callow Batta]]'s tenure at the [[University of Sanbra]]. However, the Doctor was known to give the occasional anti-Imperial lecture during the course of his teaching.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
